watches.description: For the Grand Tonneau, we developed an all-new bamboo-style bracelet, designed specifically for both the Ultra Thin and Jump Hour models. It is fitted with a perlage-finished butterfly clasp and features quick-release end links for added convenience. watches.name: MANHATTAN 37 BRACELET
watches.description: The Manhattan has an integrated stainless steel bracelet with a butterfly clasp. The bracelet is connected to the case by means of four screws into the caseback. This small detail adds to the vintage character of the watch. We did not cut any corners with the bracelet and have a very gradual taper on the bracelet with many individual sized links. The bracelet has a satin brushed finish with polished chamfers on the side and matches the case beautifully.

watches.name: JUBILEE BRACELET
watches.description: This supple and comfortable five-piece link metal bracelet has brushed and polished finishes giving the bracelet a sophisticated look and feel. The solid endlinks are designed to match the watch case perfectly and give the overall design a solid look. Measuring 20 mm in width at the top and 16 mm width at the clasp the bracelet wears elegantly around the wrist, while being safely locked with an engraved butterfly clasp with pushers.

watches.name: MANHATTAN 37 - MSS.01
watches.description: Limited Edition of 37 pieces - Ref. MSS.01 We are proud to present our collaboration with the legendary Romaric André aka seconde/seconde/. “I understand that MAEN named their piece “Manhattan” with the intention of evoking the architectural grandeur, audacity and fearless ambition of New York City. Something quite impressive then. Something that makes you feel small and humble in comparison. So my creative process started with “let’s do the opposite, let’s find a way to make the watch-wearer feel gigantic...so superior and audacious that the watch wearer could almost eat the thing”…that first spark led to, well, not “eating the thing”…but “drinking it”. By just garnishing the piece with a Maraschino Cherry, I could instantly change the scale of it, going from a city to a cocktail and reverse the narrative.” - seconde/seconde/
